decisions.why: the product's own page (ideal-ms.com/product/transeasy-tackers/, read 08/09/2026) describes DegraTack and TiTack as ‘mesh fixation device[s] designed for laparoscopic and open hernia repair procedures’ — a laparoscopic MIS device/consumable, matching MIS instruments, devices and consumables. Left as the general instruments type rather than clips, since the page names it a tacker, not a clip applier. Sits inside the supplier's otherwise wholly Uncategorised 41-product division, which stays unmapped — this overrides only this one named product.

the product's own page (ideal-ms.com/product/reach-laparoscopic-staplers/, read 08/09/2026) is explicitly named and described as laparoscopic stapling technology (‘iReach Omnia’ platform, staple lengths, reloads) — a direct match to Surgical stapling devices. The product name itself distinguishes it from the supplier's separate 'REACH Open Staplers' line, which is open (not MIS) surgery and is left unmapped.

the product's own page (ideal-ms.com/product/reach-energy-systems/, read 08/09/2026) describes the 'OP9 energy platform' with 'advanced bipolar and ultrasonic energy outputs' — an advanced energy-based surgical device, matching mis:energy directly.
